company.name: Saudi Real Estate Refinance
company.shortDescription: Saudi Real Estate Refinance provides long-term financing solutions to support and develop the housing finance market.
company.description: The Saudi Real Estate Refinance Company (SRC) develops the housing finance market in Saudi Arabia. Owned by the Public Investment Fund (PIF), SRC operates in the secondary real estate market under the supervision of the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA). The company provides long-term financing solutions to support deposit-taking institutions and align mortgage portfolios with regulatory standards. As part of its role in the Vision 2030 initiative, SRC aims to increase homeownership rates and facilitate growth in the primary mortgage market.

productsAndServices.description: SRC enables originators to offer home financing solutions by refinancing their loan portfolios, providing continuous liquidity to lenders.
productsAndServices.name: Refinancing Loan Portfolios

productsAndServices.description: SRC raises capital by issuing sukuk, which helps provide liquidity to mortgage providers.
productsAndServices.name: Issuing Sukuk

productsAndServices.description: SRC aggregates loan portfolios and packages them into Mortgage-Backed Securities to sell to investors.
productsAndServices.name: Mortgage-Backed Securities (MBS)

productsAndServices.description: SRC provides short and long-term funding to partners for housing financing, collateralized by housing financing contracts.
productsAndServices.name: Short Term & Long Term Funding

productsAndServices.description: SRC offers a long-term financing solution for deposit-taking partners, matched with an equivalent portfolio of conforming financings.
productsAndServices.name: Long Term Structured Deposit

productsAndServices.description: SRC acquires housing financing loans from partners on a recourse basis, where non-performing loans are repurchased or replaced by the seller.
productsAndServices.name: Portfolio Acquisition with Recourse
